title: Converge the guarded burn-graph CLI
goal: Verify Assignment scheduling, public command behavior, documentation, and one explicit repair loop before accepting v0.1.0-dev.2.

prompt.objective: Verify guarded Assignment identity, automatic successor scheduling, fairness, concurrency, and idempotent completion.
instructions: Use focused integration tests and inspect the real service diff.
Treat duplicate Assignment creation or cross-Graph mutation as blockers.
doneWhen: Focused scheduler and concurrency tests pass.
One Actor can receive parallel work from multiple Runs without direct node selection.
Equivalent completion replay is idempotent and conflicting replay fails.

prompt.objective: Replay Help, Start, Next, Current, Focus, Done, inspection, recovery, loops, and removed-command failures through the public CLI.
instructions: Use only public CLI commands for runtime mutations.
Verify returned packets contain the prompt and exact return protocol.
doneWhen: A repair route returns Attempt 2 with prior Decision context.

prompt.objective: Verify product, BDD, architecture, Help, and user documentation describe the same guarded CLI.
instructions: Search for superseded commands outside historical dev.1 evidence.
Keep the normal AI loop short and recovery exceptional.
doneWhen: Current documentation contains no executable legacy command.
Progressive Help describes every public command.
Assignment and Viewer boundaries are explicit.

prompt.objective: Choose pass only when the converged public CLI satisfies every M02 exit gate.
instructions: Use real tests, Help output, dogfood state, and the final diff.
Route repair for any confirmed public-loop blocker.
doneWhen: Exactly one declared route is returned with concrete evidence.
